location.requires: Seller's real operating location and shop/pickup address, entered in src/business.ts (address and fulfilment[].address).

serviceAreas.requires: The pickup and/or delivery methods the seller will actually run. For delivery, an allowlist of serviceable PIN codes in fulfilment[].servicePins.

policies.requires: Seller-written cancellation/returns, safety/handling and privacy texts in business.policies.

taxTreatment.requires: Seller's GST/tax treatment and any delivery charge, set in business.tax and fulfilment[].chargePaise. Until then the amount is labelled Estimated.

licences.requires: Seller's valid explosives/fireworks sale licence(s) for the operating location. Verify privately, never commit scans; record only a non-sensitive reference and date.

onlineOrdering.requires: Written legal confirmation that accepting crackers orders online or through WhatsApp is lawful at the seller's location. The Supreme Court order of 23 Oct 2018 restricts online acceptance and sale; see docs/LAUNCH.md.

permittedProducts.requires: Confirmation that every listed product may be sold at the location, including joined crackers/laris (dc-023, dc-024) and any green-crackers-only rule.

saleDates.requires: Sale and delivery dates permitted by the applicable authority for the seller's location this year.

certification.requires: Per-product certification evidence (for example PESO approval or green-cracker QR verification). No product is currently claimed certified or green.

hostApproval.requires: Written confirmation from the chosen host that this business and product category is permitted under its current terms. GitHub Pages does not qualify: its terms bar sites primarily facilitating commercial transactions.
